content:
Beyond the ongoing $50 discount on AirPods Pro 3, today's 9to5Toys "Afternoon Picks" headline features a $184 price cut on the titanium 46mm Apple Watch Series 11, $130 off the aluminum Cellular model, and other models starting from $299. Rare deals on the Apple Keyboard and black Magic Mouse are still going strong (for some reason), and my personal favorite, the Anker Prime Power Bank which doubles as a wall charger, also has a solid discount. But the real focus of today's accessory deals is the Nomad anniversary site-wide sale, including rare discounts on MagSafe chargers, phone cases, and Find My trackers.

Pick up the all-new AirPods Pro 3 this summer for nearly $50 off, with other models starting from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3　$200 (originally $249)
  • AirPods 4　$99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 (with ANC)　$149 (originally $179)

Back in stock: Amazon titanium 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 discounted by $184

This deal sold out in a flash yesterday — if you're interested, don't hesitate today. The 46mm GPS + Cellular Apple Watch Series 11 with Slate titanium case is once again discounted by $184 on Amazon.

Amazon is currently selling the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular model with Slate titanium case and Black Sport Band for $564.97, with free shipping.

This is one of the premium titanium case models, priced at $749. Take advantage of today's potentially fleeting deal to save $184 — it's one of the best prices we've recorded for this configuration. It briefly dropped to $550 before Prime Day last month, but otherwise, this is the lowest price we've recorded for this combination.

To reiterate, this deal is only for those who insist on the Slate titanium case — because even with the discount, it's not exactly cheap. However, the more popular aluminum models in the Series 11 lineup also have $100 and $130 discounts this week:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11　$299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11　$329 (originally $429)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular　from $399 (originally $499)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular　from $399 (originally $529)

Rare Apple Keyboard and black Magic Mouse deals (for some reason) still going strong, historical lows from $80

Plenty of hot Apple product deals — $50 off AirPods Pro 3, up to $130 off the most popular Apple Watch Series 11 models — but Magic accessory deals are rarer. However, the basic Magic Keyboard, the full-size model with Touch ID, and the black Apple Magic Mouse still have extended Prime Day discounts.

Before these extended Prime Day discounts, similar Apple accessory deals were extremely rare, and it's hard to predict how long these deals will last.

  • Black Apple Magic Mouse　$80 (originally $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard　$80 (originally $99)
  • Full-size Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID　$145 (originally $179)

All three products are the lowest prices we've recorded on Amazon. The black Apple Magic Mouse hasn't dropped this low in a long time (I'm planning to buy a spare myself), and both Magic Keyboard models are at historical lows — the basic version has only dropped to this price once before, while the Touch ID version has never been below $158.

If you've been wanting to replace your Apple Magic input devices, now that Prime Day pricing is still available might be the best time.

Nomad anniversary site-wide sale officially kicks off: rare deals on MagSafe chargers, phone cases, watch bands and more

Rare 20% off: Nomad Metal and Glass 25W Qi2 MagSafe Stand Charger

There are plenty of cheaper 25W Qi2 MagSafe stand chargers on the market, but almost none look as premium and beautiful as Nomad's latest model. It's not exactly cheap, but with the brand's 2026 anniversary sale now underway, we've found rare discounts on both 2-in-1 and 3-in-1 models that can handle your entire Apple external device setup.

Nomad's 2026 anniversary sale is now live, with huge discounts on iPhone 17 cases, wallets, Apple Watch bands, and other charging accessories — but deals on models like the Stand One and Stand One Max are among the rarest:

  • Nomad 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One　$103 (originally $129)
  • Nomad 3-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One Max　$135 (originally $169)

What you're seeing now is Nomad's latest generation 25W Qi2 MagSafe stand charger. They're currently being sold at 20% off, which doesn't sound like much, but these products almost never go on sale.

We're talking solid metal construction, very weighty premium craftsmanship, paired with glass accents, providing an elegant and luxurious home for your Apple devices.

The only downside to this sale is that the brand-new Cosmic Orange colorway isn't included:

Rare discount: Nomad Tracking Card — Apple Find My Pro model, Cosmic Orange, Google Find Hub and more

The Nomad anniversary sale is now live. Although there was some confusion about discounts on the Tracking Card Pro and Air earlier, they are now officially in effect. The discount amount isn't huge, but it's a rare price drop — Apple Find My and Google Find Hub versions start from $32.

Nomad's tracking cards can be considered the gold standard in their category, supporting MagSafe wireless charging — I never leave home without mine:

  • Tracking Card Air　$32 (originally $35) Apple Find My or Google Find Hub versions
  • Tracking Card Pro　$41 (originally $45) three colors

Nomad Titanium Stratos Apple Watch Band anniversary sale 20% off (rare discount)

Anker Prime Power Bank with display that doubles as a wall charger drops to $70 this summer — my personal favorite

Anker's 2026 summer sale continues, with rich discounts on the latest Prime charging devices, chargers, desktop chargers, 25W MagSafe stand chargers, and more. One of my personal favorite portable charging products from the brand is also back at a 2026 low of $69.99 — this 9,600mAh Anker Prime Power Bank that doubles as a wall charger.

This 9,600mAh Anker Prime Power Bank is currently selling for $69.99 on Amazon, with free shipping. Originally priced as high as $90, we've recorded this deal multiple times this year, but I want to make sure we don't miss it this week, since it has been my most practical everyday portable charging device for nearly a year.

Of course, there are higher-wattage chargers in the brand's new product line, offering larger capacity and faster charging output, but this one is already sufficient for my needs. It's one of the more compact models, easy to slip into my carry-on items, while featuring a smart display, USB-C connectivity, and enough power to last through a full day out — or even longer.

Click here for my hands-on review.

It's also one of the few models in the product line that can double as a wall charger. There are foldable prongs on the back that can be plugged directly into a wall outlet to charge the internal battery while also functioning as a wall charger — I love this design because it means I don't have to carry a separate piece of equipment just for charging.

Today's accessory and charger deals:

  • This 140W 4-port charger can power your entire device setup, today down to $35 (41% off)
  • Charge your iPhone and AirPods with this dual Qi charging pad, now $30 (originally $70)
  • The 250W Anker Prime Charging Station with LCD display can replace six chargers, now from $95
  • Belkin 100W USB-C GaN wall charger drops to $25.50, an all-time low on Amazon
  • Satechi's latest ChargeView 140W desktop charger with display returns to Prime Day low of $80
  • Add four Matter-certified Edison smart bulbs to your Apple, Google, or Alexa smart home, each under $8
  • Add premium Matter-certified ambient lighting to your home, Govee 3-pack Permanent Outdoor Lights Prism, from $430
  • Add this DOCKCASE 2-in-1 USB-C SD card reader to your tech organizer, today down to $7 (47% off)
  • Rare deal: Belkin 25W UltraCharge Pro 3-in-1 MagSafe Stand Charger hits all-time low on Amazon
  • Anker's latest 45W Nano Charger with smart display available in multiple colors, deal maintains at $26
  • UGREEN FineTrack Slim Find My wallet tracker with MagSafe charging, today down to $18
  • This magnetic Apple Watch band today down to $20 (save 41%)
  • Anker 10-port flat plug power strip now down to $20 on Amazon

Anker 3-port 160W smart display charger maintains Prime Day deal price (33% off), other models from $8

In addition to ongoing discounts on the Anker smart display Qi2 25W charger and the latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging station, we've also recorded the 3-port 160W Prime Charger with display returning to Prime Day pricing (33% off).

The official Amazon Anker store is currently selling the 3-port Prime Charger with smart display for $99.99, with free shipping.

For a product that's essentially a wall charger, this price point isn't cheap, but it features a built-in smart display, and is "as compact as the AirPods Pro 3 charging case" while delivering up to 160W — both portable and sufficient for all your devices.

More specifically, it can output up to 140W from a single USB-C port, capable of charging a 16-inch MacBook Pro from 0% to 50% in 25 minutes.

Speaking of the smart display, it features AnkerSense View technology, allowing you to "monitor power in real time on screen, switch modes instantly, and unlock custom modes via Bluetooth through the app."
